Each small square ( □ ) is equal to 1. There are 10 small squares in each strip. There are 100 small squares in each large square.

[Image: Base-ten blocks showing units, hundreds, and tens]

What number is shown?
figure_description: On the left are 8 individual small squares arranged in two columns of 4. In the middle are 3 large 10 × 10 squares representing hundreds, overlapping diagonally from front-left to back-right. On the right are 5 vertical strips, each made up of 10 small squares stacked vertically.
